ns2:course.label: Statistical Methods II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of PSYC 406. Experimental design, including Latin Squares, factorials, and nested designs; expected mean squares; analysis of covariance; emphasizes the general linear model. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Credit is not given for both PSYC 407 and SOC 587. Prerequisite: PSYC 406.
